title: Deployments manage replicas
summary: A Deployment describes how many matching Pods should run and how their template looks. A replica is one copy.
introduction: A Deployment describes how many matching Pods should run and how their template looks. A replica is one copy. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Deployment describes how many matching Pods should run and how their template looks. A replica is one copy.

blocks.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: club-web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: club-web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: club-web
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: nginx:stable
blocks.title: Deployments manage replicas

blocks.text: The desired state asks for two Pods matching the template. Reading this YAML does not create them.

blocks.text: The selector must match the labels on the Pod template.
